author: GamingBolt
description:
Mafia: Definitive Edition is, by its very definition, a great way to enjoy the original experience thanks to a handcrafted remake that made it a great addition to the PS4’s library when it was released around six years ago. Well, that edition now has a native PS5 version, which is a free upgrade for existing owners. 

There’s a lot to unpack, so join us on an adventure that has remained memorable over the years and will continue to do so for a long time to come thanks to its significance and well-paced tale of betrayal, revenge, and individual morality operating within organizational hierarchies.
title: Mafia 1 Remake PS5 Review - Is This Worth A Trip Six Years Later?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Black Myth: Zhong Kui places the burden of surpassing the game that came before it squarely on the shoulders of a new protagonist who already seems like they’ve got enough on their plate to deal with. Why lay this burden on a seemingly troubled individual when the first game's protagonost might just be waiting for a new challenge?

We’ve got some ideas after watching the franchise's new lead take on some deadly threats with a sword instead of a staff, and a whole lot of questions that we know we’re not getting answers to anytime soon. That doesn’t stop us from asking them though, and we’re always happy to have you join us on every new train of thought we get on. This one’s got quite a few stops, so get comfortable.
title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui's NEW Gameplay Proves ONE Major Thing

author: GamingBolt
description:
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots is finally breaking PS3 exclusivity when it drops on multiple platforms as part of Master Collection Vol. 2. If you’re thinking of diving in, we’ve got a few things to keep in mind before you do, as this one’s among the franchise’s more interesting entries and has since remained behind a veil of mystery as the world moved on to new platforms. 

But is its return to the spotlight worth your time? That’s what we’re going to try and help you decide as we take you through everything you need to know about this entry. Join us as we tell you why Solid Snake’s final chapter is one you could find very memorable, with a few caveats thrown in.
title: Metal Gear Solid 4 - (Master Collection Vol. 2) - 15 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy
